title: Ill Gotten Gold... Vegetables
description: Ill Gotten Gold... Vegetables — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Yakov Smearnov

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Collect 20 Golded Pumpkins and 45 Golded Ears o' Corn from the golded farms in Upper Ratsputin's Gulag and return to Yakov Smearnov in Ratsputin's Holding Cell.

Quest Reward: Gold and 2 King's Coins

Return to: Yakov Smearnov

Repeatable: No

Zone: Ratsputin's Gulag (Quest)

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Collect 20 Golded Pumpkins and 45 Golded Ears o' Corn from the golded farms in Upper Ratsputin's Gulag and return to Yakov Smearnov in Ratsputin's Holding Cell.

Offer:

We must step up our efforts to discover the cure needed to reverse the farm golding curse that is troubling us so. The scientists are saying that a breakthrough is imminent, so let's throw some more golded vegetables at them.

Make your way to the farms in Upper Ratsputin's Gulag and collect the required amount of golded vegetables. Once you have them return to me, Yakov Smearnov, here in Ratsputin's Holding Cell.

Turn-in:

You have the vegetables? Very good. Hand them to me please. Let me know when you want to go on this quest again.

Objectives:

  • Golded Pumpkins ×20
  • Golded Ears o' Corn ×45

Level range: 80–100
